remarks:
1.09 acres and a blank canvas for your next adventure! Build your dream home, create a weekend retreat, or enjoy the property as your own recreational escape. 

This residentially zoned parcel offers a combination of privacy, flexibility and convenience, with public water and electric available at the street. Access is already improved with a newly built-up driveway and new drainage piping/culvert, saving you an important first step in developing the property. 

Future construction will require a septic system and propane for fuel. Whether you're ready to build or looking for land to enjoy while planning for the future, this property offers an exciting opportunity to make it your own. 

Trailer on property is NOT included in sale and will be removed before closing.

Survey was completed less than 2 years ago and can be used as an affidavit of no change.
